content: Use a self-contained Euclidean-parameterization proof. From primitive triple derive pairwise coprimality; parity lets us rename so y is even and x,z odd. The odd factors z-y and z+y are coprime and multiply to x^2, hence are odd squares a^2,b^2. Put m=(a+b)/2 and n=(a-b)/2. Converse excludes a common prime divisor. No intermediate fact is needed because all lemmas are proved internally in the target fact.
